methodology.cash_scaled_exposure: Invested-sleeve factor exposure multiplied by the policy's portfolio exposure. Cash is assigned zero factor exposure.
methodology.coverage: covered_normalized_weight reports the fraction of the invested sleeve with usable factor data.
methodology.invested_sleeve_exposure: Weighted mean factor z-score among holdings with available point-in-time factor data.
methodology.missing_values: Missing factors are never filled with current or future data.
